entities.summary: John Proctor Darragh was a Canadian professional ice hockey player. Darragh played the forward position for the Ottawa Senators in the National Hockey League (NHL) and its predecessor the National Hockey Association (NHA). Darragh was a member of four Stanley Cup championship teams and a NHA championship team (1915). He was an older brother of NHL player Harold Darragh.
